name: [🐰] Cocos Time Trial 2 ⏰
desc:
Welcome to Coco's Time Trial 2! the sequel to Cocos Time Trial. Try to get the best times and flex your world records! 🏃‍♂️

Upload your records with the hashtag #CocosTimeTrial2 so they can be added! ✅

Make sure to like and favorite the game for more updates! 👍

Made by Gusx1000 (aka Coco*), special thanks to Luminous, Carbon, Nezy, Fleet, BlueTexturePack, Quart and Elliot for helping develop the game! 🤗
Credits to Jadon for the Rainbow Sprint inspiration 🌈
Big thanks to valkdevz for coding the replay system! ❤

TAS GAME: https://www.roblox.com/games/105012117579920/TAS-Cocos-Time-Trial-2 🔴
